parameters.name: All
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to remove all tags from the instance. Valid values:

*   **true**: removes all tags from the instance.
*   **false** (default): does not remove all tags from the instance.

> If you specify both this parameter and the **TagKey.N** parameter, this parameter does not take effect.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~473763~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The resource type. Set the value to **INSTANCE**.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun r-kvstore untag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type INSTANCE --all false --resource-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --tag-key demokey --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun r-kvstore UntagResources --region cn-hangzhou --All false --ResourceId.1 'r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000' --TagKey.1 demokey --ResourceType INSTANCE --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
